summary: Reduces initial JavaScript and unnecessary browser test environments while preserving application checks and test coverage.
warning: Installed posts, saved revisions, execution and controller output are unchanged. Storage recovery, installed schema/hash checks and binding validation remain eager. Optional authoring/output operations now load their code on first use; unavailable chunks follow existing action failure and receipt handling. This changes loading boundaries, not post authority or storage formats.

checklist.schema: The app advances once to 0.0.694. UPID, post, machine package, engine API, project, revision, transaction and recovery export schemas are unchanged. Domain exports and typed service signatures remain compatible.
checklist.events: Execution event kinds, fields, ordering, route selection and translation are unchanged. Geometry and planning algorithms are unchanged.
checklist.capabilities: Installed post capabilities and agent tool contracts are unchanged. Deferred services preserve full arguments, results, cancellation and final freshness guards. Lightweight package limits and installation-context checks are separated from archive/execution code; existing public exports remain available.
checklist.auditAndOutput: Exact post resolution, physical preflight, sandbox/conformance, audit and controller file rules remain intact. Saved-revision generation and download keep truthful receipts on module or post failures, including already-saved revision identity. No physical controller verification is claimed.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No migration, installed-package rewrite or saved-revision change. Initialization, transaction recovery, stored post schema/hash validation and machine binding checks remain eager. Only optional package preparation/installation, artifact generation, revision deletion and install-time conformance loading are deferred. Read-only hosted recovery remains available through its guarded shared operation.
checklist.verification: Independent original/integration reviews verify guard and receipt preservation, eager validation and exact test selection. Final integrated suite passes all 206 files and 2,063 tests (four workers, 54.35 seconds): 42 pure Node files/346 unchanged identities and 164 browser files/1,717 tests, with no missing or duplicated files or changed test sources. App/tooling TypeScript and production build pass. Five cold native Chromium cases pass, exercising cache startup, real DXF workers/cancellation, complete package installation, saved controller output and blocked recovery download. Same-dependency 0.0.693/0.0.694 initial JavaScript closures are 943,343/884,876 raw bytes and 271,604/256,755 gzip bytes (6.2%/5.5% lower), including all static imports/preloads. This is a transfer-size comparison, not a measured startup-time or total-asset reduction. Generated post contract parity, 25 documentation pages/81 files, STEP source distribution, three UPID fixtures, three unchanged Robofil fixtures and complete package validation pass; GitHub repeats complete verification before merge.

testedPosts.scope: Unchanged Robofil 2.6.0 implementation passes all three conformance fixtures and complete package validation. Cold native complete-package installation and saved controller output pass with deferred modules; no physical controller verification is claimed.

publicNotes.summary: Opening the workbench requires less JavaScript while keeping storage and installed-package checks intact.
changes: Optional package and output features load their code when first used.
Startup still validates installed packages and runs required transaction recovery before editing.
Action failures retain the existing diagnostics and saved-artifact or revision receipts.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed posts, saved revisions, agent tools and controller output rules are unchanged. Optional actions still require their code to load successfully before running.
publicNotes.action: Continue using the normal workflows. If an action fails, inspect its diagnostic and retained receipt before retrying; do not regenerate a saved result merely to retry its download.
